title: State the phase-sharp pre-wrapper extension of factor_iff_pre.
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

One interface lemma. No new κ, no supplier admission, and no selected-frontier change. Selected κ stays `0.001672660197076918`.

`HyperplaneEnd/Labels.lean` proves `factor_iff_pre` only at scale 1: if `(N)` holds and `C` is invertible, then `L^{-1} T_U T_E^{-1} R'^{-1} = C ⊗ id` if and only if `R' = R`. This package states the scalar extension

```text
L^{-1} T_U T_E^{-1} R'^{-1} = λ (C ⊗ id)    iff    R' = λ^{-1} R
```

and checks it. A rank-1 residual can satisfy the scaled equation for an `R'` that is not `λ^{-1} R`, so invertibility of `C` is necessary. For monomial wrappers the only scales are fourth roots of unity, and the pre-wrapper phase field is the whole freedom.

## Task and overlap

Base `bb4bccbf42844d2801487450727c2f63e10d1d0f`, priority revision 6. Task `formal-interface-lemma`, scope **refined**: the post-side phase-sharp lemma is already in `research/hpe-post-wrapper-lemma`, which explicitly does not claim this pre-side extension. `research/hpe-prewrapper-binding` (PR #2706) separates the pre-side implication and leaves the arithmetic unrun.

**Item 24** of the chronological open-#1166 list after dropping tasks already delivered or performed by an open PR through #4123, then catalogue cards not already on that list. The full numbered list is in the #1166 finding text prepared with this PR.

Nearest overlap: Jeremy Kothe PR #593 (`factor_iff_pre`), Aaron Wang `research/hpe-post-wrapper-lemma` (post side only), Riquelme Soares PR #2706. This does not restate those results.

## Validation

CPython 3.12, standard library only. Registered replay passed locally:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/hpe-pre-wrapper-phase
```

`PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/hpe-pre-wrapper-phase outcome=completed`

Evidence: ten equational replays over `Q(i)` at sizes 2 and 3, each with an invertible one-entry failure shift; one singular-`C` control; exact `Z[i]` circuits on certified pairs 1–3 (shipped and dead-bit pre-wrappers only at `λ = 1`; three phase shifts only at `i^{-t}`; four non-phase pre-wrappers miss all four roots; `C8` rejected). `--self-test` rejects a phase-shifted shipped pre-wrapper as `λ = 1` (it holds at `i^3`).

Not run: Lean/Mathlib 4.21.0, a selected cold replay, hosted CI. No cold `(E = 0)` pair is in `Exact.lean`.

## Credit

Jeremy Kothe, PR #593, for `factor_iff_pre` and the certified pairs. Aaron Wang for the post-side phase lemma. Riquelme Soares, PR #2706, for the pre-side audit that left this arithmetic open. Gate semantics follow the five kinds in `HyperplaneEnd/Clifford.lean`.

Prepared by unpaidmoon with substantial Cursor Grok assistance. Apache-2.0. No independent human or formal-kernel review.

## Open next questions

Kernel-check the scalar statement beside `factor_iff_pre` in a successor of `Labels.lean`. Blocked here by no Lean toolchain; the frozen file is not edited.

Bind one cold `(E = 0)` literal with the same gate semantics. Blocked because `Exact.lean` has no cold pair.
